dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Chiefs (8-2) Week 12 Briefing: Friday Injury Report Ahead of Bills
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: DT Omarr Norman-Lott (knee) logged limited practice reps Friday [Ron Kopp Jr.](https://www.arrowheadpride.com/kansas-city-chiefs-injuries/217609/chiefs-bills-week-12-final-injury-report-kenneth-walker-ruled-out). OT Jaylon Moore (ankle) and RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) did not practice Friday, while DT Peter Woods (neck) and QB Patrick Mahomes (knee / right elbow) practiced in full [chiefs.com Official](https://www.chiefs.com/news/week-12-injury-report-chiefs-vs-bills-2026).

Week 12 Bills Outlook: Andy Reid and DC Steve Spagnuolo open installation for the Buffalo Bills (9-1, BUF -3, HC Joe Brady, OC Pete Carmichael Jr. & DC Jim Leonhard (Road Test))—a unit ranked #1 in Rushing EPA / Game (+3.02) as Kansas City prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [Jared Sapp](https://www.arrowheadpride.com/kansas-city-chiefs-odds/217427/chiefs-vs-bills-predictions-week-12-picks) [Kramer Sansone](https://www.arrowheadpride.com/kansas-city-chiefs-roster/217562/chiefs-bills-madden-simulation-week-12-happy-thanksgiving).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 8-2 (1st in AFC West • #5 Seed in AFC), Kansas City carries a 98.5% postseason projection, 45.3% AFC West division title mark, and 14.2% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Ben Solak](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50563522/week-12-seven-things-solak-thinks-chiefs-bills-giants).
Around the Beat: How to Watch and Listen | Week 12: Chiefs vs. Bills [chiefs.com Official](https://www.chiefs.com/news/how-to-watch-and-listen-week-12-chiefs-vs-bills).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Kansas City ranks #7 in Points / Game (27.1), #2 in Points Allowed / Game (16.3), #4 in Turnover Differential (+6), giving Andy Reid and Steve Spagnuolo a clear benchmark ahead of Thu, Nov 26, 7:20 PM CST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Buffalo Bills [Dakota Watson](https://www.arrowheadpride.com/kansas-city-chiefs-power-rankings/217434/week-12-ap-nfl-power-rankings-chiefs-climb-to-top-3-ahead-thanksgiving-matchup).
